subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be implemented as a LINE/plugin-owned opt-in buffer, as a generic channel SDK/gateway media coalescer, or deferred in favor of existing text debounce plus narrow channel fixes?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes turn boundaries, latency, config shape, and channel lifecycle semantics, so maintainer intent is needed before code should be queued.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
options.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in the affected channel plugin first, using shared SDK helpers only where they clearly reduce duplication.

options.title: Design a generic coalescer
options.body: Create a broader channel SDK or gateway media coalescing contract before channel-specific implementation, accepting a larger API and compatibility review.

options.title: Defer batching changes
options.body: Leave text debounce and Telegram album handling as the supported behavior and handle only narrow channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
recommendation.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in the affected channel plugin first, using shared SDK helpers only where they clearly reduce duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans shared debounce policy, plugin boundaries, config compatibility, and messaging-channel product behavior.
